{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history includes negative values (e.g., -0.25 or 0.50), indicating bearish sentiment.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show a sharp decline following a peak.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 10-15%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent true values if sentiment is neutral or positive (0.00), to avoid over-optimism.",
    "Correct for lag: if model forecasts are 3-5 days ahead of true outcome, adjust downward by 2-5% for each lag day.",
    "Avoid over-optimism after spikes: if model forecast exceeds true outcome by >10% in 3 consecutive days, reduce by 15-20%.",
    "Use sentiment as a filter: if sentiment is positive (0.50), allow slight upward bias, but cap at +5% above recent mean.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast, apply a downward bias of 3-7% to prevent overestimation."
  ]
}
